text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I prepared a special present for my 
beloved Rickey-chan♪ Here it comes~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sending a big heart straight to you～♪ 
Sparkly, kyun～～～!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"How was it? Did Falco's feelings reach 
you? Please accept my gift of l-o-v-e♡ 
Just kidding—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, I'm so touched! Thank you, 
Falco-san!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You see, Falco-san, the fire energy you 
possess has incredible power to ward off 
bad luck and invite good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I receive qi from Falco-san like that, 
the upcoming year is guaranteed to be a 
happy time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah! W-W-Wait a sec! No, that's not it! 
Falco was waiting for you to call me out 
on that, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Like, "Wait, the thought is the ENTIRE 
gift?!" Don't worry, I prepared a real 
present too~!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Eeh, are you sure I can take more? It 
feels like I'm receiving too much~!
